acceptance_criteria: Extend replay frame metadata to accept optional detector_observations as sanitized observation dictionaries only.
Replay manifests still require synthetic:// frame sources and reject invalid observation bbox/confidence/shape through the existing domain contract.
build_replay_inspection_snapshot can attach review-only observations using ManifestDetectorAdapter built from validated artifact intake metadata.
/inspection/replay and /ws/inspection keep the existing safe empty observation state when FLANGE_QC_V2_ARTIFACT_INTAKE_DIR is missing or unready.
When artifact intake is ready and replay metadata contains observations, the HMI snapshot includes observation label, confidence, bbox, manifest model_ref, and evaluation evidence reference.
Detector observations remain advisory only with no PASS/NG, no model deserialization, no inference, no camera access, no model promotion, and no production authority.
Existing artifact intake, shadow detector status, HMI, replay, detector adapter, audit persistence, and product CI behavior continue to work.

retrieved_decisions: Detector observations may be review-only evidence.
Detector output cannot emit PASS/NG or approve production authority.
Artifact intake metadata is env-var-bound and validates model manifests before shadow use.
retrieved_lessons: Connect MLOps-facing metadata in small steps.
Preserve empty observation state when intake is missing.

Existing artifact intake endpoint, shadow detector status endpoint, no-camera replay, HMI, and detector adapter behavior remain valid.
